journey.name: ED-10 Leaving during an in-flight save drops it silently
journey.description:
KNOWN-DEFECT WATCHLIST. Asserts the current behaviour; whether it is the right behaviour is a product call. See qa/TEST-PLAN.md.
onSave runs in viewModelScope. Popping the editor destroys the back stack entry, which clears the ViewModel, which cancels the scope and with it the createTask call still inside FakeTaskApi's delay. The task is never created, the user is never told, and there is no snackbar behind this one the way there is behind a delete.
Neither half is visible below the device: a unit test cannot pop a back stack entry, and the ViewModel test that covers a failed save covers a save that returned, not one that was cancelled.
The latency knob makes the window wide enough to tap Back inside it. The wait afterwards is what separates "cancelled" from "still on its way".
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0 --es qa_latency_ms 5000

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Type "Walked out on" into the "Title" field
Immediately tap the element with the content description "Back", before the save completes
Verify that the app returns to the "Tasks" screen
Wait ten seconds, which is twice the pinned call latency
Verify that "Walked out on" is not on screen
Verify that no error message and no "Task deleted" message are on screen
Verify that exactly four elements with the content description "Delete task" are on screen
